status: PROPOSAL. Not in the playable roster. Owner decision 5 (T3-14).
overallNote: Computed by the existing OVR V2.1 formula (src/overall.js compute). The formula selects the "Traditional centre-back" archetype, which values positioning and composure, his documented weaknesses. No per-player override is proposed; the owner may decide whether ELITE tier with an 83 OVR is acceptable (tier is career status, OVR is attributes).

personality.note: See proposals/personality-v1-proposal.json. Adventurous positioning, ambitious distribution, long-range shooting.

rationale.peak: 2014-2017: PSG and Chelsea (2016-17 Premier League champion in a back three).
rationale.pace/agility: Mobile and athletic for a centre-back (79 pace, 82 agility).
rationale.technique/passing: Genuine ball-playing defender: comfortable carrying out and hitting long diagonals (tech 84, pass 85, vision 84).
rationale.shooting: Dangerous long-range and free-kick shooter (shooting 84), but not a finisher (finish 60).
rationale.defending: Strong in duels and recovery (def 86, tackling 86) but positioning 76 and marking 78 reflect well-known lapses.
rationale.composure: Base composure 68 and v1.1 composure 74: decisions under pressure could be rash (2014 World Cup semi-final).
rationale.traits: Libero (carries out of defence when covered) + Architect (ambitious progressive passing); different families as required by the V5.4.1 rule.
